hpe_html_decode.brief: 把原始文档字节解码为 UTF-8 / Decode a raw document byte buffer into UTF-8

params.raw: 原始文档字节，为 `NULL` 时返回空串 / Raw document bytes; a `NULL` value yields an empty string
params.len: 原始字节数 / Raw byte count
params.out_len: out:结果的 UTF-8 字节数，可为 `NULL` / Result byte count, may be `NULL`
params.out_enc: out:探测到的编码，可为 `NULL` / Detected encoding, may be `NULL`
params.out_from_meta: out:置 1 表示编码来自文档内声明，可为 `NULL` / Set to 1 when the encoding came from an in-document declaration, may be `NULL`

hpe_html_decode.return: 新分配且以 NUL 结尾的 UTF-8 字符串，永不返回 `NULL` / Newly allocated NUL-terminated UTF-8 string, never `NULL`
hpe_html_decode.details: 嗅探顺序即 HTML 规范规定的顺序：BOM 优先，其次是前 1024 字节内的 `<meta charset>`（或 `http-equiv="content-type"`），最后用严格的 utf-8 校验在 utf-8 与 latin-1 之间抉择。| The sniff order follows the HTML spec: a BOM wins, then `<meta charset>` (or `http-equiv="content-type"`) within the first 1024 bytes, and finally a strict utf-8 validation decides between utf-8 and latin-1.
hpe_html_decode.note: 调用方负责用 `hpe_free` 释放返回值；UTF-8 BOM 会被剥掉 / The caller frees the result with `hpe_free`; a UTF-8 BOM is stripped

hpe_encoding_name.brief: 取得编码的小写名称 / Obtain the lowercase name of an encoding

params.enc: 待命名的编码 / Encoding to name

hpe_encoding_name.note: 供开发/测试钩子使用的标签 / A label used by the dev and test hooks
